summary: Sweep bug-26..bug-32: immediate dispatch feedback, cleaner production.json paste, batch music upload, manual-only task creation (Gemini removed), main-account-only update publishing, and a telegram_relay ingest fix.
changes: Stage/restart/publish actions now show an immediate starting indicator.
Pasted multi-bubble production.json no longer shows a spurious 'send the rest' prompt, and the raw JSON bubbles are deleted after acceptance.
Add Music File now accepts many files in a row, finished with a Done button.
The Gemini automatic script-generation mode was removed; production.json is manual-only (file, paste, or agent prompt).
Update publishing is gated to the main account; clones are notified of changes and pull via Sync from source.
telegram_relay source ingest now has the token it needs (GH_TOKEN) to fetch its release asset.
